title: Just Completed $3.5 Billion in Funding, Moonlight Confirmed to Be Preparing for a Hong Kong Stock Market Listing, Attracting Attention

content_html:
According to reports, the AI large model company Moonshot plans to submit an IPO application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as early as this month, with an estimated fundraising scale of about $3 billion. However, as of now, Moonshot has not publicly responded to or confirmed this information.

According to the information, Moonshot recently completed a Series F financing round exceeding $3.5 billion, with a post-investment valuation of $35 billion. It is reported that due to the funding amount in this round exceeding three times the original target, the company has ended the Series F financing earlier and has advanced the start of the Series G (Pre-IPO) round, which was originally scheduled for August, with a pre-investment valuation further increased to $50 billion.

An insider close to Moonshot said that the previous round of financing reached $3.5 billion, while the IPO fundraising target is around $3 billion. There is a certain discrepancy in the scale of funds, so the market still keeps a close eye on the related listing plan.

In recent years, as the AI large model industry has entered an accelerated commercialization phase, the frequency of financing and capital operations among leading AI companies has significantly increased. Moonshot has gained attention in the domestic AI application market with its large model product Kimi, and its capital activities have become an important window for observing the commercialization process of Chinese AI companies.

content_html_zh:
据报道，AI大型模型公司Moonshot计划最早本月向港交所提交IPO申请，预计募资规模约30亿美元。 不过，截至目前，Moonshot尚未公开回应或证实这一信息。

资料显示，Moonshot近期完成了超过35亿美元的F轮融资，投后估值达350亿美元。 据悉，由于本轮融资金额超过原定目标的三倍，公司提前结束了F轮融资，并提前启动了原定于8月份进行的G轮（Pre-IPO）轮融资，投前估值进一步提升至500亿美元。

一位接近Moonshot的内部人士表示，上一轮融资达到35亿美元，而IPO融资目标在30亿美元左右。 资金规模存在一定差距，因此市场仍密切关注相关上市计划。

近年来，随着人工智能大模型产业进入加速商业化阶段，人工智能头部企业的融资和资本运作频率显着增加。 Moonshot凭借大型模型产品Kimi在国内人工智能应用市场获得关注，其资本活动也成为观察中国人工智能企业商业化进程的重要窗口。
